title: Traditional Saudi Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and aromatic dish from Saudi Arabia, made with tender lamb and a rich blend of spices.

ingredients.name: Tagine
ingredients.notes: Traditional clay pot or substitute with a Dutch oven

instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in the tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
2. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
4. Add the lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the beef broth, spice blend, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
6. Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the tagine and transfer to the oven.
7. Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and easily shredded with a fork.
8. Garnish with parsley and serve hot.
9. Serve with couscous or rice, if desired.
